Soft-glam makeup, dialed down further — barely-there, soft brown-toned eyeliner drawn close to the lash line with NO visible wing or flick at all, and a sheer, natural tinted lip balm with barely-there color (NOT a saturated, bold, or fully-opaque lip color), dewy luminous skin. Polished and put-together, but reads as effortlessly gorgeous and mainstream-appealing — never heavy, costume-like, or theatrical.
contestants.figure: Striking hourglass figure — full bust, cinched waist, curved hips. Built for bodycon and corset silhouettes. Carries herself with deliberate posture, always aware of how the outfit sits.
